card.text: Explore Geographos in 3D with its published radar shape model.

introduction.text: Geographos is an elongated near-Earth asteroid reconstructed from Goldstone radar and optical light curves. Explore its original shape and radial heights. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery. The 1994 equatorial radar geometry leaves north–south ambiguity: local feature latitudes and thickness are model-dependent. This view retains the archived 1999 radar model; the reference radius is derived from this mesh volume and is not an independently measured physical mean radius. No resolved optical surface map is supplied.

shape.title: Radar shape model
shape.summary: Radar shape with north–south ambiguity. Local latitudes depend on the model; no surface imagery is mapped.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Radar height relative to a 1.284 km sphere. North–south ambiguity leaves heights and latitudes uncertain.
